deck: Enabling Atlassian Connectors for Microsoft Copilot
purpose: Admin enablement/governance package to ALLOW the Atlassian Jira & Confluence connectors to be used (not a specific agent/design). Provides the MSFT-side artifacts a customer Cyber/Security team needs to approve usage.
audience: Customer Cyber/Security review board + Power Platform/M365 admins
scope_note: Enablement of the connectors themselves. Per-agent design/architecture is a separate, downstream workstream led by the customer architecture team.
assumptions_to_validate: Connector technology = Microsoft Copilot connectors (Graph connectors) for Jira & Confluence (confirm vs Power Platform / Copilot Studio connectors)
Auth method, exact token TTL, and storage specifics require Security SME sign-off

governance_surfaces.admin.microsoft.com: Microsoft 365 admin center — Copilot connectors / Search & intelligence data sources; Integrated apps consent
governance_surfaces.admin.teams.microsoft.com: Teams admin center — app management + permission/setup policies for the Atlassian app surface
governance_surfaces.admin.cloud.microsoft.com: Microsoft 365 admin (Copilot Control System) — agents & connectors governance

design.rules: pure-black canvas, pine accent, zero emoji, gradient-border tiles + inner glow
